# correlate

In [EhOsContract.Process](process-dsl.md), section `process`.

```elixir
correlate fields
```

The fields that tell which run an event belongs to, in order.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| `fields` | `atom \| list(atom)` | yes |  | One field, or a list of them; every included event carries each. |
